# Oishii Nori — Your Sushi Story

> A Filipino-owned kitchen serving authentic Japanese food with a distinctive Filipino twist -- sushi, baked sushi, ramen, takoyaki, and cafe drinks in Santa Cruz, Laguna, Philippines.

Oishii Nori is a single-location restaurant known for baked sushi, maki rolls, ramen, and cafe drinks, made fresh daily. Filipino-owned, made for everyday cravings, at everyday prices.

## Location

Pedro Guevara Ave, Santa Cruz, Laguna 4009, Philippines

## Delivery

Delivers to every barangay of Santa Cruz, Laguna, and to nearby towns (Pagsanjan, Pila, Lumban, Magdalena, Victoria, Calauan, Cavinti, Luisiana, Nagcarlan, Liliw, Bay, Pakil, Kalayaan, Paete), with a fee per barangay or town; the full list and fees are at https://www.oishiinori.com/delivery.

## Hours

Open daily. Current hours are shown live on the homepage and About page (they're admin-configured and may change).
